plugin.note: Use Protect from Melee or a safespot for regular Hellhounds. Demonbane melee is the primary setup, Venator bow is strong in Catacombs, water Magic is accurate against the water-weak variants, and hard clue scrolls are the main regular-task reward.

requirements: 75 combat is required for Hellhound assignments.
No Slayer level is required for regular Hellhounds.
91 Slayer is required to fight Cerberus normally, or 86 Slayer with a wild pie boost.
Karuulm Slayer Dungeon Hellhounds require boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete.
Buccaneers' Laboratory requires 76 Sailing and Charred Dungeon requires 60 Sailing.
Wilderness Slayer Cave, Wilderness Resource Area, Vet'ion, and Calvar'ion methods require accepting player killing risk.
mechanics: Regular Hellhounds only attack with melee bites.
Protect from Melee prevents regular Hellhound damage when not safespotting.
Hellhounds are demonic creatures, so Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow, and Demonbane spells apply where relevant.
Level 122 and level 136 Hellhounds have a 50% water weakness and very low Magic defence.
Hard clue scrolls are the main notable regular-task drop at 1/64, or 1/32 in the Wilderness with an imbued ring of wealth.
Catacombs Hellhounds cannot be cannoned, but they can drop Ancient shards and Dark totem pieces.
Wilderness Slayer Cave Hellhounds use the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table and have a 50% increased smouldering stone drop rate.
Vet'ion and Calvar'ion each summon two Skeleton Hellhounds before enrage and two Greater Skeleton Hellhounds after enrage.
Cerberus is stronger than regular Hellhounds and has separate boss mechanics and unique drops.

methods.label: General protection
methods.summary: Use demonbane melee with Protect from Melee for normal Hellhound tasks, or safespot with Ranged or Magic when conserving supplies.
recommendedFor: players choosing between speed, clue hunting, Catacombs value, and Wilderness risk
requiredOrKeyItems: Ring of wealth (i) for Wilderness clue hunting
steps: Choose a location based on assignment source, desired drops, and risk tolerance.
Use Protect from Melee when fighting regular Hellhounds directly.
Use Emberlight or Arclight as the main melee weapon because Hellhounds are demonic.
Use safespots with Ranged, Magic, halberds, or salamanders when avoiding melee damage.
Bring a ring of wealth (i) in the Wilderness if chasing hard clue scrolls.
risks: Wilderness locations add player killing risk.
Regular Hellhounds have few valuable drops outside hard clue scrolls and tertiary drops.
notes: Protect from Melee is enough for standard Hellhound damage control.
The standard task loop is simple; location choice matters more than monster mechanics.

methods.label: Stronghold Slayer Cave cannon
methods.summary: Use the Stronghold Slayer Cave as the primary non-Wilderness cannon location for regular Hellhound assignments.
steps: Enter the Stronghold Slayer Cave and use one of the Hellhound rooms.
Set up the dwarf multicannon in the room.
Keep Protect from Melee active while cannon and demonbane melee handle kills.
Use the four rooms of three or four Hellhounds to keep the task moving.
notes: The task page highlights Stronghold Slayer Cave as the primary outside-Wilderness location because it has multiple Hellhound rooms and allows cannoning.

methods.label: Catacombs Venator bow
methods.summary: Use Catacombs Hellhounds for Ancient shards, Dark totem pieces, and low-attention multicombat kills, especially with Venator bow.
recommendedFor: Ancient shard and Dark totem farming
requiredOrKeyItems: Bonecrusher or ash sanctifier if desired
steps: Use the Catacombs of Kourend Hellhound room when Ancient shards or Dark totem pieces are desired.
Stand where multiple Hellhounds can path into Venator bow bounce range.
Keep Protect from Melee active or use the available safespot.
After aggression expires, run south and climb up the vine to the Giants' Den, then return to reset aggression.
risks: A dwarf multicannon cannot be used in the Catacombs.
This is usually slower than cannoning at Stronghold Slayer Cave.
notes: Catacombs are multicombat and can be fairly AFK with Venator bow.

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave
methods.summary: Use Wilderness Slayer Cave for Krystilia-style tasks, cannon support, Wilderness weapon speed, and the boosted smouldering stone chance only when accepting PK risk.
recommendedFor: players seeking the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table
requiredOrKeyItems: Ring of wealth (i) for hard clue scrolls
steps: Bring only items you are willing to risk.
Set up the cannon in the Hellhound section of the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Use a Wilderness weapon or demonbane melee while Protect from Melee is active.
Use the available safespot when ranging or maging.
Stay alert for player killers and leave early instead of trying to finish a kill.
risks: The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a popular player killing hotspot.
Do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.
Multicombat makes escape harder if a team appears.
notes: The level 136 Wilderness Slayer Cave Hellhound has 150 Slayer XP and access to the cave drop table.
The smouldering stone drop rate is increased by 50% from these Hellhounds.

methods.label: Safespots
methods.summary: Safespot Hellhounds with Ranged, Magic, halberds, or salamanders where the location supports it.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ranged weapon, Magic weapon, halberd, or salamander
Water spell setup for water-weak variants
steps: Use Ranged, Magic, halberds, or salamanders from a safespot.
In Catacombs, stand on the east side of the hallway to safespot Hellhounds.
In Wilderness locations below level 20 Wilderness, stand so that teleporting remains practical if player killers arrive.
Use water spells when choosing Magic against level 122 or level 136 Hellhounds.
notes: Safespots trade speed for safety and lower supply use.

methods.label: Vet'ion and Calvar'ion summons
methods.summary: Vet'ion and Calvar'ion summons can progress Hellhound tasks, but they are primarily boss-trip choices rather than efficient Slayer methods.
recommendedFor: players already killing Vet'ion or Calvar'ion
steps: Enter the Vet'ion or Calvar'ion encounter only when prepared for the boss fight.
Kill the two Skeleton Hellhounds summoned midway through the first phase.
Kill the two Greater Skeleton Hellhounds summoned midway through the second phase.
Treat the four summoned Hellhounds per boss kill as task progress, not as a primary Hellhound training method.
risks: Vet'ion and Calvar'ion are common player killing hotspots.
The summoned Hellhounds have no drops other than the looting bag.
notes: Use Vet'ion/Strategies for the boss mechanics.
Choose the named monster in the catalogue to use its dedicated strategy, equipment, location and preparation requirements.

advisor.coverageStatus: Task alternative reference; choose the dedicated monster strategy for its complete equipment and requirements

methods.label: Cerberus choice
methods.summary: Use Cerberus only when the account meets the Slayer requirement and wants boss uniques rather than a fast regular Hellhound task.
recommendedFor: players using a wild pie boost from 86 Slayer
requiredOrKeyItems: 91 Slayer or 86 Slayer with wild pie
Emberlight, Arclight, or Scythe of vitur
steps: Choose Cerberus only when boss profit or unique drops are the goal.
Use Ward of Arceuus to reduce summoned soul prayer drain where appropriate.
Use Emberlight, Arclight, or Scythe of vitur as recommended melee weapons.
Follow Cerberus/Strategies for boss positioning, summoned souls, lava pools, and ghost timing.
risks: The summoned souls can drain up to 90 Prayer, or 60 Prayer when Ward of Arceuus is used correctly.
Poor setups can consume too many prayer potions compared with regular Hellhound kills.
notes: Cerberus is a task alternative with boss mechanics and valuable uniques, not the standard fast task option.
Choose the named monster in the catalogue to use its dedicated strategy, equipment, location and preparation requirements.

advisor.coverageStatus: Task alternative reference; choose the dedicated monster strategy for its complete equipment and requirements

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Tune supplies around clue hunting, prayer sustain, tertiary drops, and Wilderness risk.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ring of wealth or ring of wealth (i)
steps: Bring Prayer potions if using Protect from Melee for long trips.
Bring a dwarf multicannon only at cannonable locations.
Use Soul bearer if collecting ensouled hellhound heads.
Prioritize hard clue scrolls, ensouled heads, smouldering stones, Ancient shards, and Dark totem pieces as the meaningful regular-task loot.
For Wilderness trips, keep risk low and leave space for clue scrolls or cave drops.
notes: Revenant hellhounds do not count for normal Hellhound tasks.
Bouncer and the quest Skeleton Hellhound have special quest-only task-count exceptions.

styleOptions.label: Demonbane melee
styleOptions.summary: Primary regular-task setup using demonbane melee and Protect from Melee.

styleOptions.label: Venator ranged
styleOptions.summary: Ranged option for Catacombs AFK tasks or safespotting regular Hellhounds.

styleOptions.label: Water Magic
styleOptions.summary: Magic option for safespotting water-weak level 122 and level 136 Hellhounds.

body:
# Hellhounds

Use Protect from Melee, demonbane melee, cannonable locations, Catacombs Venator bow, or Wilderness Slayer Cave depending on risk and reward preference. Regular Hellhounds are simple melee attackers; the important choices are location, clue hunting, and whether to use Catacombs, Wilderness, Vet'ion/Calvar'ion summons, or Cerberus as alternatives.
